system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

While you are in your Flash state and would make an attack, you can spend a superiority die. You convert your speed into kinetic energy overwhelming the target on a hit. The affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw vs the Jutsu’s save DC (If Weapon or Unarmed, Taijutsu save DC). On a failure, they become Dazed.
